- **will** + V: *I'll call · It won't rain · Will you help?* (*'ll*, *won't*)
- **be going to** + V: *I'm going to buy · She isn't going to come · Are you going to stay?*
- **Present Continuous** (am / is / are + V-ing) + time: *We're meeting at six.*
- **Present Simple** — timetable: *The film starts at 8.*
- **Shall I / we** + V? — an offer: *Shall I open the window?*

After *when, if, as soon as, before, after, until* — **Present Simple** even about the future: *I'll call you when I **get** home.*

В англійській немає одного «майбутнього: English has no single “future tense” — you choose the form by where the future comes from: decided just now (will), planned earlier (going to), already arranged (Present Continuous) or a timetable (Present Simple).
